name: northtalk
description: NorthTalk syntax highlighting and language server for .talk files

northtalk.profile.description: The Lint profile the language server reports advice from.

northtalk.manifest.description: Path to a Host Manifest (*.talk-manifest.json). A relative path resolves against the first workspace folder. Empty selects the single manifest in the workspace roots, if there is one.

northtalk.server.runtime.description: The JavaScript runtime that runs the language server, such as `node` or `bun`. Empty uses the editor's own Node runtime.

northtalk.server.path.description: The `northtalk` CLI script to launch with `lsp`, such as a checkout's tooling/cli/src/main.ts under Bun. Empty uses the server bundled with the extension.

scripts.package: bun run build && bunx @vscode/vsce@3 package --no-dependencies --skip-license --out dist/northtalk.vsix
